checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: reuse saved answers across tuner versions. M1 cachedAnswers: drop tunerVersion from the reuse filter, require same modelFile/modelSize/cpu/platform/arch, never replay timed rows from another tuner version, read several run dirs; Measurements slot key ignores threads on untimed full-GPU calls. M2 verifyRestore spot-check (re-ask a few stored answers live, half with another thread count; any text mismatch disables reuse) wired into runTune with a reuseFrom option and tune:gate --update-baseline --reuse-from <home>. M3 docs (benchmarks README, ADR-123), tune:gate, commit, push.

impact_assessment.why: Measured: all 2,125 answers of the stopped v11 SmolLM2 run already existed in the Nov 13 v10 runs once threads are ignored; 2,124 identical text, 2,125 same pass/fail. A decision-rule change re-asks hours of identical answers.
impact_assessment.benefits: A tuner-version re-baseline replays stored answers and only asks new requests; the 2.9 h re-tune drops to the new requests only
impact_assessment.risks: contract: cachedAnswers gains a multi-dir input and new identity keys; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: a wrong replay would put stale answers into a profile or baseline, and timed rows replayed across versions would bias speed choices
impact_assessment.mitigation: live spot-check of stored answers before any restore (any mismatch disables reuse); timed rows never cross tuner versions; thread-insensitive keys only for untimed full-GPU-offload calls; failing-first tests; tune:gate before commit

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Fix: Measurements.restore was first-wins per slot; with threads out of the key (ADR-123) a v11 group at 8 threads blocked the v10 group at 12, so 528 saved SmolLM2 answers were re-asked live

impact_assessment.why: The v11 re-baseline re-asked answers it should replay
impact_assessment.benefits: every saved group adds the items its slot lacks; a re-baseline replays them
impact_assessment.risks: contract: restore returns true when it added any item; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: a saved item never replaces one already in the slot, fresh or restored
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first test; full suite; tune:gate 9/9 unchanged

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Fix: cachedAnswers read the 3 newest runs and the starting tune's empty run took one slot, so a v10 run with 14,115 answers dropped out of a re-baseline; empty runs no longer count, and an explicit --reuse-from reads every matching run (row cap unchanged)

impact_assessment.why: The v11 re-baseline found 1,467 saved answers instead of about 15,000
impact_assessment.benefits: a re-baseline replays the long earlier run
impact_assessment.risks: contract: cachedAnswers skips runs whose record has answers 0; runTune passes limitRuns Infinity with reuseFrom; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: more saved rows may be read, still capped at 20,000
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first test; full suite; tune:gate 9/9 unchanged

checkpoints.description: [1/1] tune:gate --update-baseline tunes in <home>/gate-baseline-work, which survives a kill; a restart moves the killed attempt's runs to saved/ and replays them (ADR-124)

impact_assessment.why: The v11 re-baseline was killed twice and its finished SmolLM2 tune was recovered only by copying run files by hand
impact_assessment.benefits: re-running a stopped update continues from its answers
impact_assessment.risks: contract: --update-baseline (re-tuning) no longer uses a temp home; dependency: none; concurrency: a pid file refuses a second live update, not a lock; state: saved runs accumulate until an update finishes
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first tests in a temp dir; normal gate and --from-profile unchanged; ADR-124 and docs
